interpretation_grid.PASS_loop_segregation_converts_limbic_lo: preconditions met (ENOUGH divergent seeds + loops carry LIVE cross-loop variance + the in-layer null VERIFY-LIFTS + learning engaged) AND C1 (A1_LOOPS committed-class entropy strict-above A0_SINGLE_ARENA AND the valid in-layer null on a strict-majority of divergent seeds) AND C2 (A1 strict-above ARM_DROP_LIMBIC -- the limbic loop is load-bearing). Loop segregation CONVERTS committed-action diversity where the single F-dominated arena plateaued -> the single-arena collapse WAS a binding constraint on the F-dominance conversion ceiling (MECH-439) -> supports ARC-110.
interpretation_grid.PASS_loop_segregation_converts_limbic_no: preconditions + C1 met BUT NOT C2 (dropping the limbic loop does NOT remove the lift). Loop segregation converts, but the associative loop (or the loop structure per se) carries it -- the limbic loop is not the sole driver. Still supports ARC-110 (segregation converts); the per-loop load-bearing attribution is partial.
interpretation_grid.FAIL_valid_null_loops_vary_but_no_conver: DECISIVE. preconditions met (a VALID in-layer null can now be constructed -- ARM_NOISE verify-lifts -- and the loops carry live cross-loop variance) BUT A1_LOOPS does NOT lift committed-class entropy strict-above A0/the null. The single-arena collapse was NOT the binding constraint -> the F-dominance conversion ceiling is INTRINSIC, not an artefact of collapse -> weakens ARC-110 (the loop-segregation-as-artefact hypothesis).
interpretation_grid.FAIL_substrate_not_ready_requeue: A precondition is unmet: too FEW divergent seeds (pool collapsed), OR the loops carry NO live cross-loop variance (a vacuous split pinned to the motor winner -- the ARC-110 what_would_answer guard), OR the S2 in-layer null did not VERIFY-LIFT above A0 (the same-layer null is still inert even with loops -> null-validity problem persists), OR learning was not engaged (finer channels not dissociable / delta_t flat). The conversion question could NOT be measured -- NOT a falsification.

autopsy_note_2026-06-28: ROOT-CAUSE of ARM_DROP_LIMBIC == A1_LOOPS byte-identical on all 6 seeds (C2 untestable): the segregated loops never received the named cortical channels they partition. Defect 1 (FIXED 2026-06-28): ree-v3/ree_core/agent.py gated the per-head finer-channel dict on the top-level config.use_finer_channel_gating (never set in ree_core -> always False) while the selector reads config.e3.use_finer_channel_gating, so score_bias_channels was always None and only the lumped residual/mech341/route reached the loops (all -> associative); the limbic loop was empty in EVERY arm (its nonzero pref_range is a settling-on-zeros artefact), so the DROP map (ofc/liking/vigour -> associative) was a no-op. Defect 2: the 707 driver did not enable use_ofc_analog/use_mech295_liking_bridge/use_tonic_vigor. Defect 3 (C2 release blocker): the named bias heads emit per-candidate-FLAT output (OFC input range 0.028 -> output 0.0; dacc/lpfc/vigour 0.0; gated_policy ~7e-4), so under per-loop zscore they are inert regardless of module enablement (verified modules-on DROP still == A1). MECH-191 phasic-externalisation gap. CONSEQUENCE: 707's C1 dynamics did NOT exercise the cortical loop decomposition; this run does NOT validate ARC-110 either way (already non_contributory / PROMOTES NOTHING). C2 = ablation-inert/substrate-blocked.
